proves.claim: nextFor reads item_needs rows through a primary-key range, so no statement it prepares scans board_meta.

store.io-board-next.needs-read-uses-key-.why: Without this test the item_needs read was a LIKE ... ESCAPE that scanned all 815,588 board_meta rows, 0.7 s on every nextFor call (20 Nov).

proves.claim: nextFor's median time with 81,559 board_meta history rows stays under 200 ms and within 2x of the same board without them.

store.io-board-next.cost-flat-with-meta-.why: Without this test next's cost grew with every board_meta row the board kept, and a 200 ms budget on an empty fixture proved nothing about the live board.
